project.description: The project in which the instance belongs. If it is not provided, Terraform uses the provider default. **Do not** manage the same instance with `google_bigtable_instance_iam_policy` alongside `google_bigtable_instance_iam_binding` or `google_bigtable_instance_iam_member`; authoritative policy replaces the full IAM policy and will conflict with incremental resources.
project.rationale: Project locator for the resource; exclusivity with binding or member resources is a Terraform lifecycle concern documented by the provider.

instance.description: The name or relative resource id of the Bigtable instance whose IAM policy is set.
instance.rationale: Selects the instance; the instance name alone does not authorize callers.

policy_data.description: Policy document from a `google_iam_policy` data source. This resource **replaces the entire IAM policy** on the instance; omitting bindings can remove owners or admins unintentionally. Prefer binding or member resources unless you intentionally own the full policy document.
policy_data.rationale: The full policy body defines every binding at once; mistakes can revoke access or grant excessive access in one apply.
